content: पिच्छम् [पिच्छ्-अच्] .²1 A feather of a tail (as of a peacock); <ls>Bhāg. 10. 12. 4</ls>. .²2 The tail of a peacock; शिखिपिच्छलाञ्छितकपोलभित्ती <ls>Ki. 12. 41</ls>; क्षणमलघुविलम्बिपिच्छदाम्नः शिखरशिखाः शिखिशेखरानमुष्य <ls>Śi. 4. 50</ls>. .²3 The feathers of an arrow. .²4 A wing. .²5 A crest. .{@-च्छः@} A tail in general. .{@-च्छा@} .²1 A sheath, covering, coat. .²2 The scum of boiled rice. .²3 A row, line. .²4 A heap, multitude. .²5 The gum or exudation of the silk-cotton tree. .²6 A plantain. .²7 An armour. .²8 The calf of the leg. .²9 The venomous saliva of a snake. .²10 A betel-nut. .²11 A diseased affection of a horseʼs feet.
